about: Commands that run something on the device now (ping, traceroute) instead of reading or changing configuration. Each takes | json like a show command.

help.ping: Send one echo request from this device and wait for the reply
Send one echo request from this device and wait for the reply

help.traceroute: List the routers on the way to an address, one probe per hop

help.query: Ask a time server for its stratum and this clock's offset, without setting anything
